SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Fishing in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Fishing in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Eastern Africa.
   C. Treat Fishing in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Fishing in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

13. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

14. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
